title: Asam Sahitya Sabha Bhasanawalee Part 4 (অসম সাহিত্য সভা ভাষণাৱলী - ৪র্থ খণ্ড)
author: Jatindranath Goswami (Comp.)
description: Anthology of historic presidential addresses delivered at the annual sessions of the Asam Sahitya Sabha between 1955 and 1970. Key addresses focus directly on the linguistic documentation, alphabet preservation, and folklore collection of the minority Tai languages of Upper Assam.
source: Jorhat: Asam Sahitya Sabha, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451248

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ ၼႆႉ ၵဵပ်း ႁူမ်ႈ ၶေႃႈ ၵႂၢမ်း လၢတ်ႈ ၶွင် ၸဝ်ႈ ပၢႆး လိၵ်ႈ တီႈ ပၢင်ၵုမ် လူင် ဢႃႇသမ်ႇ သႃႇႁိတ်ႉယႃႇ သၽႃႇ
sentences.text_roman: pap nai kep hum khɔ khwam lat khawng chaw pai lik ti pang kum lung a sam sa hit ya sa pha
